title: Ehipassiko peace walk ends; monks depart Sri Lanka with ‘Aloka’
byline: A group of monks, including Vietnamese nationals Pannakara and Ratanaguna, who visited Sri Lanka to take part in the “Ehipassiko – A Global Walk for Peace,” concluded their journey and departed the country this morning (29).

title: Babar–Mendis blitz powers Peshawar Zalmi into PSL final
byline: Peshawar Zalmi stormed into the PSL final with a commanding 70-run win over Islamabad United, driven by a scintillating partnership between Babar Azam and Kusal Mendis.

title: “Dog ‘Aloka’ may have been a monk in previous life” – Ven. Pagnakara Thera
byline: Vietnamese Buddhist monk Ven. Pagnakara Thera says he believes a dog named ’Aloka’ may have been a monk in a previous life, speaking at a Dhamma session held yesterday at the Kelaniya Rajamaha Viharaya.

title: Harassing calls and messages now punishable under law: Police
byline: As incidents of digital harassment and misuse of personal contact details continue to rise, Police have reiterated the legal safeguards available to protect the public.

title: Another USD 625,000 goes missing
byline: Days after a major controversy took the nation by storm over the missing USD 2.5 million money heist which went missing from the Treasury which was to be paid to Australia’s Export Finance Agency, Cabinet Spokesman Minister Nalinda Jayatissa yesterday revealed another shocking theft claiming that USD 625,000 which had been released by the Sri Lanka Post to be paid to the US Post had also gone missing.

title: Trump’s face to feature on commemorative US passports
byline: The US will release a limited number of passports that feature a portrait of US President Donald Trump, the White House has confirmed.

title: Trump says King Charles does not want Iran to have nuclear weapon
byline: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday Britain’s King Charles did not ​want Iran to have a nuclear weapon, introducing the fraught subject of ‌the Middle East conflict into comments at a White House state dinner for the visiting royal.

title: Essential services declared under Emergency regulations following Cyclone Ditwah
byline: A Gazette Extraordinary has declared a wide range of public services as essential in response to the post-disaster situation caused by Cyclone Ditwah.

title: Japan Airlines trials humanoid robots as ground handlers
byline: Japan Airlines (JAL) will start using humanoid robots in ground handling tasks at Tokyo’s Haneda airport from May, in a two-year trial it said is aimed at easing employees’ workload.

title: Indian billionaire’s son offers to save Escobar’s hippos
byline: An Indian billionaire’s son has offered to help Colombia get rid of a problem it has grappled with for years - a herd of hippos linked to notorious drug lord Pablo Escobar.

title: Sports Minister takes over SLC administration after mass resignation
byline: Sri Lanka’s Sports Ministry has taken over the administration of Sri Lanka Cricket with immediate effect after Sports Minister Sunil Kumara Gamage accepted the resignation of President Shammi Silva and the Executive Committee.

title: Former FBI director charged over alleged social media photo threat to Trump
byline: Former FBI Director James Comey has been charged with threatening the life of US President Donald Trump, a formal accusation that stems from an image he briefly shared on social media.

title: Prima increases wheat flour price by Rs. 5 from today
byline: Prima Company has announced an increase in the price of wheat flour with effect from today (29), citing rising transportation costs.

title: Eran non-committal on Sri Lanka Cricket
byline: Former MP Eran Wickramaratne was non-committal on reports which said he is to head an interim committee which will take charge of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC).

title: SLC chief Shammi Silva resigns
byline: Sri Lanka Cricket President Shammi Silva has officially resigned from his post with immediate effect, the board said in a statement.

title: Sri Lanka wins first Gold at Asian Beach Games 2026
byline: Sri Lanka secured its first gold medal at the Asian Beach Games 2026, with Air Force wrestler Nipuni Wasana Dharmadasa clinching victory in the women’s 50kg category.

title: Ramanathan Archchuna granted bail
byline: The Mallakam Magistrate’s Court today granted bail to Jaffna District Member of Parliament Dr. Ramanathan Archchuna, who had been arrested by the Ilavalai Police on April 27.

title: NSO revises 2026 Q2–Q3 power cost estimate, submits to PUCSL over rising global fuel prices
byline: The National System Operator (Private) Limited (NSO) has submitted a revised electricity generation cost estimate for the second (Q2) and third (Q3) quarters of 2026 to the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka (PUCSL) on April 27, citing rising fuel prices in the global market.

title: After 31 years in jail, Rajiv Gandhi assassination convict becomes High Court lawyer
byline: Freedom, when it came, did not just mean stepping outside prison. It meant starting over again. For AG Perarivalan, who was convicted in the Rajiv Gandhi assassination case, that new beginning is now unfolding in the courtrooms of Tamil Nadu, but on the other side of the bars. Released on remission in 2022, Perarivalan went on to study law at Bengaluru’s Dr BR Ambedkar Law College and passed the All-India Bar Examination in 2025,

title: Daily Mirror Exclusive confirmed as Shammi Silva and Co. resign
byline: In a major development that confirms Daily Mirror’s continuous and exclusive reporting, Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) President Shammi Silva and the SLC Executive Committee have decided to step down following a special committee meeting held yesterday (28), bringing an end to days of speculation and controversy surrounding the cricket administration.

title: Govt. admits to duplicate payment to RDA contractors
byline: While admitting the duplicate payments to Road Development Authority(RDA) contractors, the government yesterday said the Bank of Ceylon (BOC) which made the payment is taking action to recover the duplicate payments as per the mechanism available for such recoveries.

title: Donald Trump renews ’no more Mr Nice Guy’ warning to Iran over nuclear deal
byline: Donald Trump warned of tougher action against Iran as nuclear talks falter, criticising Tehran’s inability to strike a deal and referencing earlier threats linked to tensions around the Strait of Hormuz and recent maritime incidents.

title: Ranil skips court citing ill health – Court fixes July 8 for final progress report
byline: Fort Magistrate Isuru Neththikumara today ordered that the final progress report of investigations in the case filed against former President Ranil Wickremesinghe over the alleged misuse of state funds be called on July 8.

title: 25% of patients report gastritis symptoms, health experts warn
byline: Health experts in Sri Lanka have raised concern over a rising number of gastritis-related cases, estimating that nearly 25% of patients seeking medical attention are now presenting symptoms of the condition.

title: Rs. 100,000 fine on vendor for overcharging water on Meenagaya train
byline: A vendor operating on the “Meenagaya” train service was fined Rs. 100,000 by the Maligakanda Magistrate’s Court yesterday (28) after being found guilty of selling bottled drinking water above the maximum retail price.

title: Russian Health Minister to arrive in Sri Lanka
byline: Russian Health Minister Mikhail Murashko is scheduled to arrive in Sri Lanka on May 3 for a three-day official visit to strengthen bilateral cooperation in the health sector.

title: Electric train project for Colombo suburbs discussed
byline: Plans to introduce electric train services in parallel with the existing railway system were a key focus at a high-level discussion held this morning (29) at the Presidential Secretariat under the patronage of Anura Kumara Dissanayake.

title: Riyan Parag vaping controversy: Violation may lead to imprisonment
byline:
Rajasthan Royals’ Riyan Parag was caught on camera allegedly vaping inside the team’s dressing room during their IPL 2026 clash against Punjab Kings in Mullanpur on Tuesday night. During the 16th over of Rajasthan’s chase, Parag appeared on the live broadcast holding a vaping device, raising eyebrows.
As per BCCI rules, smoking is prohibited in dressing rooms and across stadium premises, though it is permitted in designated areas.

title: Dambulla eatery fined Rs. 510,000 for selling expired water
byline: A restaurant in Dambulla has been fined Rs. 510,000 by the Dambulla Magistrate’s Court for selling expired bottled water above the maximum retail price.

title: 2026 in a nutshell so far
byline: The coal procurement scandal has centred on allegations of systemic corruption, the delivery of substandard fuel, and major financial losses involving the state-owned Lanka Coal Company (LCC).

title: Rupee depreciates further against US Dollar
byline: The Sri Lankan Rupee continued its downward trend against the US Dollar on Tuesday (29), according to the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

title: Transformation Committee to run Sri Lanka Cricket until fresh elections: Minister
byline: Sports Minister Sunil Kumara Gamage said a “Cricket Transformation Committee” has been appointed to rebuild Sri Lankan cricket and guide it toward a stronger future.

title: Treasury Secretary informs he will not appear before CoPF tomorrow
byline: Secretary to the Treasury Dr. Harshana Suriyapperuma has informed the Committee on Public Finance (CoPF) that he will not appear before the committee tomorrow.

title: Two people stabbed in Jewish neighborhood in north London
byline: Two people were stabbed on Wednesday, April 29, in a north London neighborhood with a large Jewish community. A man was arrested after he was seen running with a knife ’’attempting to stab Jewish members of the public,’’ the Shomrim Jewish neighborhood watch said on social media. It said the two people were being treated by Hatzola, a Jewish volunteer ambulance service.

title: Fatal bus accident in Hatton claims one life, leaves dozens injured
byline: A tragic accident occurred today, when a private passenger bus fell into a 35-foot precipice in the Badalgala area of the Hatton-Dayagama road. The bus was traveling toward Hatton at the time of the incident.

title: Eran Wickramaratne appointed Chairman of Sri Lanka Cricket Transformation Committee
byline: Former Member of Parliament Eran Wickramaratne has been appointed as the Chairman of the Sri Lanka Cricket Transformation Committee, following a sweeping administrative overhaul at Maitland Place.

title: 11 cancers on the rise in young people - scientists find first clue why it’s happening
byline: Eleven cancers are becoming more common in young people in England, a major analysis shows.

title: Donald Trump renews ’no more Mr Nice Guy’ warning to Iran over nuclear deal
byline: Donald Trump warned of tougher action against Iran as nuclear talks falter, criticising Tehran’s inability to strike a deal and referencing earlier threats linked to tensions around the Strait of Hormuz and recent maritime incidents.

title: SJB urges Eran to quit party over SLC role
byline: The Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) has requested former MP Eran Wickramaratne to relinquish his party membership following his recent appointment to head Sri Lanka Cricket’s Transformation Committee.

title: All out: End of an Empire?
byline: Eventually and finally the Empire that was Sri Lanka Cricket came to its long-awaited end yesterday as incumbent president Shammi Silva and his executive committee decided to officially step down, making way for what many believe could be the beginning of a new era for the country’s best-known passion and most marketable brand name.
